notes.title: Bloodlines of Shadow Springs DEMO
notes.content:
We work on this game in collaboration with LessonOfPassion team. This demo gives you access to the introduction and the first week of the game. You'll meet main characters, get familiar with the story, gameplay and visuals.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/631fe8a7a504d65cf26cb0c620b6a1326efe9f68.jpg

In full version:

Evolve from Newborn into the powerful Nosferatu
Hunt your prudish classmates and hot milfs
Use different mind control abilities to get what you want
Reveal the secrets of your  lineage
Defeat another vampire clan, and become the only ruler of Shadow Springs!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1580160/Bloodlines_of_Shadow_Springs/

notes.title: Devlog #9
notes.content:
TV studio is finished
The level is not that difficult (11 items to find), but full of funny scenes of TV studio backstage.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/02051c1f004befee7d41b8996c484fcd7eb0b053.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/06686898e5dae8a18478ba093ce9f14c12668992.gif

The last level
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/5980f926ec4a490952db1050b872ffd9d0fa6760.gif
All the art for the game has been drawn, we just have to complete a few animations and combine everything together (the last level - “fitness club” and the final cutscene). 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/d8411a2362310fc04d7e1b7891d5a83b463a47bd.gif
So  we will have the final build of the game approximately in a month.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/3b2a05caeac0489184b302c19a50d9bc64f50211.png

The situation with Valve and release date
So far, we still have to get through the review on Steam, but we are working on it and believe in success. So January-February 2020 look extremely realistic.

Thank you for being with us these years! Thanks to your support (more than 4,000 subscribers!), we managed to get into almost 20,000 wish lists!

notes.title: Devlog #8
notes.content:
Island adventure
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/87fd31eadd722f99ef50c0c4041bba17fb1f1f15.jpg

The 8th level is finished, we wanted to create an atmosphere of adventure films about Indiana Jones - a grail, a refrigerator, rope bridges and mysterious caves. There is even a Nazi submarine!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/3ab76e3ec001afdb77d0644b53e635d2f46e45ad.gif

Also some references to Soviet cinema :)


TV Studio, Level #9
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/39d3c70d84ee2f0f8078f83dfa081583e9df44dd.gif

This level is already completely drawn, now we create animations for the characters. Would you like to know how the news, sitcoms and television games really are filmed? 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32265702/86035ca81f1ede40fa9e6f4300366e4ee2f5e0f4.jpg

You will be able to see it soon.

Fitness club, level #10, finally!
The work  has begun, we are on to the finish line now!

Lesson Of Passion games on Steam
If you didn’t notice, LOP have already published 2 of their games on Steam. In addition to Blind Date 3D, the desktop version of the datesim Eleanor 3 is also available!

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35434564-Lesson-of-passion/#browse

notes.title: Devlog #7
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/3b72c3fd480d0490a59c087123f15befede3c44d.gif

Summer Time
We wish you have great vacations!
And we continue to work on Perky Little Things. The characters for the Vikings are already drawn and animated. Now we have to put them all together. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/8c1d208cb9a85f03e603056da7f678fdbae1689d.png

In the meantime, work on island adventures is in full swing. Treasure hunters, hot military and tribal girls and many movie references - it will be a bomb!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/6cabb46602e455acf8b4846850df40c6921086f4.png

Demo update
Yes, we would prefer to keep the intrigue until the release, but ... we decided to add the Wild West to the demo as well (and it’s already available on Steam). We hope you enjoy art style and humor.

Android version
Why not? The updated demo is also available for mobile devices, so you can download it at https://luxobscura.itch.io/perky-little-things

Blind Date 3D
Our friends and partners Lesson Of Passion announced their first game on Steam! http://store.steampowered.com/app/1115650/Blind_Date_3D

Is it possible to seduce a girl on the first date?
Or will it be your friend's wife?
Can the whole party goes crazy?

Wait for this release on Steam!

notes.title: Devlog #6
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/2a22d6a237cff9bf5dfa35b88fc0af3b368b2b62.gif

From Transylvania With Love
Completed! This time, you have to find 20 items (and so far it’s my favourite level!).

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/aa25e1c234efba19f68100666756d531dc7cd463.gif

Vikings’ Adventures
The background is ready! Now the artist is working on the characters.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/e15ede442f5f19ea2ddd107e8e5fa51eba3cd4a7.gif

Wild West
Another group of artists almost finished the Wild West. Now we are animating the characters and hope to put it all together soon.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/c4aaa89e6bd7e38a1e1fbd2bc04c428c9c0766ba.jpg

At this moment we use 2 art teams to finish the game as soon as possible. Wild West is created by the same artists as Sci-Fi level ("In A Black Hole Far Away"), so it looks and feels a bit different but still great. Maybe we will give you a taste of it in a further demo update :) 

And we hope we can find some more awesome artists to work on PLT expansion after release to make it more diverse.

Updated demo
Demo has now uncensored (Adults Only 18+) mode, music can be muted, improved stability on some video cards.

Yes, Master!
Meanwhile, ktulhusolutions will be a publisher for the game Yes, Master!
It’s an erotic visual novel mixed with a point-and-click adventure.

Yes, Master! will be available for free.
Without censorship. For adult players only.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090900/Yes_Master/

Hugs for everyone!

notes.title: Devlog #5
notes.content:
Spring fling 
Hello everyone, work is in progress!
Sci-fi level "In a Black Hole Far Far Away" is completed. Pretty complex and twisted, huh.. It won’t be easy to save the space princess from lusty reptilians  :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/83877cbeb15d1fa77aa48322633b0a83dd06704e.jpg

Vampires is also almost done, but it sill needs some final touches and sound effects.

Wild West
Our answer to Red Dead Redemption! We are filling the level with details and characters.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/fc1335d4fcf7691137b0f77719205f81f77f7e91.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/1aee13e720645148bc6d9231b8d23ab57afa1c68.jpg

Any suggestions how to name it? Leave  your comments below!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/903f69fcb124412b6afcf833564ceca53ef31a43.jpg

Extra Content
Meanwhile, we also work on materials that will be available in the Founders Edition. So far it’s a book with illustrations and a bunch of wallpapers. Maybe we can think up something else.

Wallpaper samples:
https://imgur.com/0i6TJXA    (NSFW)
https://imgur.com/d3ndxSS

Demo, feedback, discord
Thanks for your feedback! We have updated the demo to fix some issues and add “Safe For Work” mode (so you can post videos on youtube if you want to). But still not sure if the full game will have this mode.

Join us on discord server -  https://discord.gg/6umfvv7
We are working closely with Lesson Of Passion team for a long time, so we decided to have a common server.  More fun!

See you!

notes.title: Perky Little Demo
notes.content:
Demo is here!
Demo is available on Perky Little Things store page for PC, Mac and Linux.
It contains initial CHRISTMAS EVE and two brand new levels! Third level will be unlocked only after the second one is completed (sic).

“Outlines” menu option
This is off by default. We prefer to have this option enabled, but on some video cards it makes characters disappear or look weird. Hopefully we can make it more stable later.

Censorship
Suddenly Valve makes us to set “Adults Only” rating for the demo (and we hoped for “Mature 17”). Anyway, it means we don’t need any extra DLC and we can just make censorship optional (in the main release).

Your feedback
It’s like an “Early Access” for us, so our main goal is to get *as much feedback* as we can. 
Please share your thoughts, issues or suggestions  here.

Thank you!
It's time to plug it in!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/10adc0920fca0fe1215c15376e181930f9c5667f.jpg

notes.title: Devlog #4
notes.content:
Happy New Year!
Good news everyone! We are finally done with the pirates level!
Perhaps we will expand it somehow later, but even now it is bigger than the previous ones. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/01eb15676b44320f2dff34a95eb02c5e76c02468.jpg

Lustful pirates, hot beauties, sharks, kraken, skeletons and of course treasures!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/b3b335447789951fbe950f5d94c7d10f8d737078.jpg

What's next?
At the moment there are 2 new levels in production at once - Vampires and Science Fiction.
Soon we will be able to tell more about it!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/e49dd41fd6cff8c1c54dd4595801624e77d2fb7d.gif

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/00f6a06407a32fd7fff8ce17ec930519865d8d5c.jpg

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/b2e627afe8b17c2b75a397087583bac257e475f7.jpg

Oh sad ...
Obviously, we do not have time to finish the game on Valentine's Day, as originally hoped. Therefore, in order not to mislead anyone, the release date will set as TBA (announced later). We want to release the game with a good set of levels, and then add some new ones in future updates.

Adult content and censorship
The game is erotic, but we would like to keep the age rating M (18+). Therefore, the AO version will be available on Steam as a free DLC.

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.content:
Slowly but surely

Hello! The development process is still in progress, although not as fast as we would like. Also it was decided to rethink the basic concept of the game a bit to make it more exciting.

Good news - we try to work with one more talanted artist, who managed to follow the art style. It will speed us up greatly in case of success. The music for intro and the “School of Magic” is also ready, it suits the game perfectly :)

Anyway, we hope autumn will be more productive, and we will be able to share news more often.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/3e33c5e310cd073ee8d0a4972aaded4454c16dd2.png

Gameplay changes, new UI
Initially, a very simple game mechanics was planned. There are 10 items at each level  that you need to find, and then hand them out to 10 different characters.

The problem was that 10 items were played at a large level ...  a bit empty. So we decided to make more items, some of which will be initially blocked. Such items become available only by use of other items, forming a kind of action "chains".

We also had to change the interface and some logic, but it's getting much better! :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/3e9559dedfcb8d349d990ddd70b9949a5cbc8853.jpg

Not all items are visible now in UI (to save a screen space), but only a part that you can "scroll through".

Pirates of Southern Seas
The level is filling with characters. Basically they are pirates :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/1681abfd31bf0d9388e2ba86ac20d056106348fc.gif

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/2b8a503a0dc69f986f335f0bc997b8cd7d228644.jpg
Story Comic
Games are based either on mechanics or story. And although we usually prefer the second option, this time the story is not so important. But we don’t  want to completely ignore the plot, so we have one! 

The story will be in the form of a comic, but it’s not yet decided if it will be animated it or not.

The main character is a beginner Cupid. Cupids should give people love and happiness in all its forms. The hero does not have any supernatural skills due to lack of experience. To get started, the angel mentor advises simply "to finish the picture," in small strokes to push people to happiness.


School of Magic is ready!
The location is approximately 6000 by 4000 pixels. 

https://i.imgur.com/mrr0t9C.gif

We still need to choose a musical background, but the author of the music theme for “Christmas Eve in Metropolis” kindly agreed to continue cooperation with us and write music for the whole game. It is assumed that each level will have its own music.
Meanwhile we begin to draw and animate the next level - "Pirates of southern seas"!

New mechanics
In addition to searching for items and characters, there will be a search for "secrets" at each level. These are certain areas in the location, which you have to poke several times with your mouse to get hidden scenes.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/797b62c0948d27075bfa814243086041e1048cb0.gif

Some rooms can become misted and you need to clean it to get a better view :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/2d361c3d8be7dea3f60b0d2b1f3a5b6922768fb7.gif

We will try to diversify the gameplay with such things.
Have any fun ideas? - Write it in the comments!

Tips
Yes, it was the missing part in Christmas Eve and now we have it :)

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265702/4e81a8742553331535939d150e4183dd8e2f130d.jpg

The button is available after cool down timer,  and when pressed - the camera moves to the next item or character. The zoom of the camera also became more convenient.

Stay with us! All for now!

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
3-2-1-Go!
Hi! The development of this game is far from complete, so we'll try to keep you informed.

It all began in late 2016. We were a little tired of developing the drama Metropolis Lux Obscura and wanted something more optimistic. So we decided to make a small Christmas card, in the style of children's books "look at the picture and find all the interesting details." 

The result was Christmas Eve In Metropolis, and we liked it so much that we almost started to make the full format game immediately. But Metropolis kept us very busy until the release in the fall of 2017 and even after it.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30709366/3a937f0e1a6aab0c24d644ac1fd5d423ae49d769.gif

When the question of the full-length game arose, it was necessary to  determine something with the levels. Should all levels be in the same setting? But can we think up enough funny scenes for this? Therefore, we decided to make everything as diverse as possible. Each level is a separate world, not connected with the rest. Pirates, vampires, tv show ... Gradually we managed to come up with a dozen locations, filled with all sorts of ... uh ... obscenities :)

And, with the support of the amazing artist Oleg Okunev (Metropolis Lux Obscura, Christmas Eve), we finally started to develop!
 
School of Black Magic
Today we want to tell you about the first of the new levels - the School of Black Magic. It was inspired by the books That-Must-Not-Be-Named. Dumb male students, sexy females, lecherous teachers, perverted elves and various fantastic creatures - oh, you won’t get bored in this school. There is not much time left to studies too.

https://i.imgur.com/vzhAA24.gif

The planned 30 scenes are already turning into five dozen animations, so we had to increase the size of the location in comparison with the Christmas one.

We will not open all the cards yet, but we have taken a good pace and soon this location will be ready!

Subscribe!
Do not forget about us! Click Follow button on the store page and add Perky Little Things to your wishlist. You will not regret! ;)

https://i.imgur.com/jtMFOyI.gif
